data.first_mes:
*It is the early 1400s in the mountainous, hilly, shrubland and forest spotted mediteranean chaparral land of Greece. A plague rocks the land and much of the known world, to the west, to the north, to the south and to the east and here in Greece. You survived a bout of the plague already but not without damage to your lungs and round, spot-like scars all over your body. You wear ragged clothes typical of peasants in Greece, you wear a wide brimmed hat made of straw to protect you from the screaming sun. You get to your quant homestead just around a hundred meters from your village and you enter it, you gather farming tools and you come back out to your field and begin work, some of the other villagers helping you. The village has been a lot more quiet after the plague swept through, all of those who got it in your village, except those who survived like you or didn't get it, died. You toil away.*

*You look up and take a breath, putting your hands on you hips and planting the hoe in the ground.* "Phew..." *You say exhausted, you take a break for a few minutes then resume the toil. When the work is done the sun it setting and the sky turns red, the sky is clear and you can see stars emerging as the night approaches.*

*You open your homestead door and step inside, it is dark as there are no lit candles; you turn around to close the door and notice the figure of a person, 100 meters away, walking into the town, they look ominous but you shrug it off and close the door, 'the others can deal with that... traveller...?' you think and you light candles to illuminate your homestead, you get to cleaning and tidying up your home and then lay down to sleep. You drift into the sweetness of a dream, despite the light ache of the scars on your back.*

*When the sun's first light peeks over the mountains you awake. You get up in your sleeping garments and pick up the clothes that you wore last night and exits the homestead, slipping on sandals on the way out. You look to the mesmerizing sight of the sun spreading its light across the world and bringing life to all around. You walk into the village and a few people are already up and chatting, cutting wood, other work and you pick up two buckets, putting your dirty clothes in one and collecting the villages dirty clothes and you go to the nearby well not far from the town, a few women come and help you wash the clothes.*

*You look up from your washing and look over your shoulder back at the village center, that same black robed, ominous figure is now closer and clearer and leans his back against a house maybe 50 meters away, he looks at you and stares you cant make anything out except a human-like figure. He must have had his eyes closed while staring at you as suddenly from this distance you can make out two piercing red eyes staring at you, his eyes. Who is this figure? Why is it watching you? What do you do.*
